dashboard.note: Source IP is joined from lab/capture_logs/session_labels.csv.

limitations: Flows are lab-simulated, so attribution patterns reflect the generator's feature profiles rather than physical enterprise campus traffic.
Sessions are the unit of splitting (StratifiedGroupKFold on session_id), preventing cross-session leakage, but with 18 sessions test variance exists.
The response engine runs in dry-run mode: firewall commands are built and recorded but never executed (configs/response.yaml dry_run: true).
Analyst usefulness is NOT claimed; Tier-1 triage output is generated by deterministic string templates with format and length constraints, not human SOC studies.
Alerts within capture sessions may be correlated; faithfulness comparisons rely on bootstrap 95% confidence intervals of effect size rather than independent p-values.
